sentences.text: AM Marine Service Oy Ab is a company registered on 2026-07-10 under the industry code 33150, repair and maintenance of civilian ships and boats.
A start-up notification and a board change were registered on 2026-07-13, and first sales and a first hire are recorded on 2026-09-01.
No grant, EU project, public contract or funding record is on file.
For the fund this is a watchlist case: the registered industry is on the thesis list, but a boat repair service shows no technology or growth evidence yet.
